home.title: Bookster
home.subtitle: Manage your book collection and share your literary discoveries with friends.
home.downloadDescription: Bookster is available for free on the App Store

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Bookster places the utmost importance on protecting your privacy. This privacy policy describes how we handle your personal data when you use our iOS mobile application.

storage.title: 2. Data Storage
storage.content: The application follows a "privacy by design" approach. Your data is securely stored on our servers (Supabase) and is linked to your user account.

dataCollected.title: 3. Data Collected
dataCollected.intro: We only collect data necessary for the application to function:

items.account: Account information: First name, last name, email address (via Apple Sign In)
items.library: Personal library: Added books, notes, ratings, reading statuses

dataCollected.deletion: Deleting your account results in the permanent deletion of all your personal data.

items.technical: Technical information about your device (except for crash reports)

security.title: 5. Security
security.content: No method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is completely secure. While we implement appropriate security measures (encryption, Apple Sign In authentication, Row Level Security), you are responsible for protecting your login credentials.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.content: You can access, modify, or delete your data at any time directly from the application. Deleting your account results in the permanent deletion of all your data.

modifications.title: 7. Modifications
modifications.content: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Significant changes will be notified to you via the application.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.content: For any questions regarding this policy, you can contact us via the contact form on

permissions.title: 9. App Permissions
permissions.intro: The application may request access to:

items.camera: Camera: To scan ISBN barcodes and take cover photos
items.photos: Photo library: To customize your profile and add book covers
items.notifications: Notifications: To receive alerts about social interactions (follow requests, etc.)

permissions.optional: These permissions are optional and can be managed in your device settings.
